_readme: Что рисует tools/art/generate.py. Описания на английском: так Stable Diffusion понимает лучше. Можно менять любое описание, стиль и настройки; новая запись — новая картинка. Вид (kind) задаётся сам: персонажи — unit, навыки и статусы — icon, поверхности — texture или cloud, пол — texture, стена — wall; поменять: {"kind": "object", "subject": "..."}.

styles.color: hand-colored woodcut engraving, bold black ink linework, fine hatching, soft watercolor tints, rich muted colors
styles.plain: woodcut engraving, black ink on white paper, fine cross-hatching, clean bold lines

negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, blurry, lowres, jpeg artifacts, text, letters, watermark, signature, frame, border, black border

unit.prompt: {style}, {subject}, full body, standing, seen from slightly above, three-quarter view, simple clear silhouette, single character, centered, isolated on a plain white background
unit.negative: multiple characters, multiple views, cropped, cut off, scenery, landscape, ground, floor, ground patch, pedestal, cast shadow, parchment, aged paper, floating objects, floating weapon, floating shield, shield, extra weapons, two weapons, double-bladed weapon, extra limbs, extra arms, extra hands, extra fingers, deformed hands, malformed weapon, bent sword, broken blade, weapon through body, horse, rider, mounted knight, castle, building, landscape background, scene

object.prompt: {style}, {subject}, the whole object, isometric three-quarter view from above, single object, centered, plain white background
object.negative: multiple objects, cropped, cut off, scenery, landscape, ground, ground patch, cast shadow, parchment, aged paper, floating objects, horse, castle, building, landscape background, scene

icon.prompt: {style}, game ability icon, {subject}, single emblem, centered, bold simple shapes, vivid colors, high contrast, isolated on a plain white background
icon.negative: multiple icons, icon grid, cropped, scenery

texture.prompt: {style}, seamless repeating pattern of {subject}, flat 2d game texture viewed straight from above, the pattern fills the entire frame edge to edge, no objects, evenly lit
texture.negative: landscape, scenery, perspective, horizon, sky, road, path, buildings, houses, trees, characters, people, frame, border, vignette, paper edge, ship, boat, sail, sea horizon, sun, sunset, moon, clouds, castle, horse, figure, scene, illustration

wall.prompt: {style}, seamless repeating pattern of {subject}, flat 2d game texture, straight-on view, the pattern fills the entire frame edge to edge, no objects, evenly lit
wall.negative: landscape, scenery, perspective, sky, ground, whole building, house, roof, door, window, trees, characters, people, frame, border, vignette, paper edge, ship, sea, sun, sunset, castle, horse, figure, scene, illustration

cloud.prompt: {subject}, a soft wispy drifting cloud, glowing, isolated on a pure black background
cloud.negative: sky, landscape, ground, horizon, sea, frame, border, paper, cropped
